title: Send to Terminal needs Invoicing & payments Create & Edit AND Customer portal ON
custom_preconds:
1. Card terminal payments are set up for the organization with a terminal reader.
  2. An invoiced, unpaid work order with a contact exists.
  3. Two custom-role users: a Control user (Invoicing & payments Create & Edit AND Customer portal ON) and a Leak user (Invoicing & payments Create & Edit but Customer portal OFF).

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Control user, open the work order Finance tab and click New Payment.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The payment dialog opens and the Send to Terminal button is shown.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the Leak user and open the same work order Finance tab and New Payment.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The New Payment dialog opens (Create & Edit allows taking payments) but the Send to Terminal button is not shown, because Customer portal is off.
